The company outlined strong 2026 projections, including 3-4% organic growth and 5-8% EPS increase, driven by strategic initiatives like expanding the Arm & Hammer brand and international growth. Executives emphasized innovation, efficient cost management, and strong cash flow, with a focus on premium product lines and carefully managed acquisitions like Touchland.

feed.summary: This article details recent executive changes across several companies in the convenience store industry, including Bazooka Brands, Murphy USA, Performance Food Group, and others. Key appointments include David Dreyer as CMO at Bazooka Brands, Terry Gallagher, Jr. as chairman of the Cigar Association of America, and Scott McPherson as CEO of Performance Food Group. The report highlights the strategic importance of these personnel moves in driving growth and innovation within their respective organizations.
